shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -c "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'next.config.*' -g 'app/**' -g 'src/**' -g 'pages/**' -g 'node_modules/next/dist/docs/**' | head -200"
/bin/bash -c "cat AGENTS.md && printf '\\n--- package.json ---\\n' && cat package.json && printf '\\n--- next.config.ts ---\\n' && cat next.config.ts"

/bin/bash -c "for f in app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/ProductGrid.tsx app/ProductSkeleton.tsx 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx' app/globals.css; do printf '\\n--- %s ---\\n' \""'$f"; sed -n '"'1,260p' \""'$f"; done'

/bin/bash -c "printf '%s\\n' '--- files ---' && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' | sort | head -200 && printf '\\n--- Next docs locations ---\\n' && find node_modules/next/dist/docs -maxdepth 3 -type f 2>/dev/null | head -120"

/bin/bash -c "sed -n '1,280p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/view-transitions.md && printf '\\n--- linking and navigating ---\\n' && rg -n \"ViewTransition|view transition|view-transition|useLinkStatus|transitionTypes|unstable\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/04-linking-and-navigating.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/streaming.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference -g '*.md' | head -160"

/bin/bash -c "rg -n '"'^##|''^###|''^> '"\\["'!|''^import|ViewTransition|addTransitionType|prefers-reduced|useLinkStatus|transitionTypes'"' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/view-transitions.md && printf '\\n--- guide lines 70-340 ---\\n' && sed -n '70,360p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/view-transitions.md && printf '\\n--- installed React versions and exports ---\\n' && npm ls react react-dom next --depth=0 && rg -n 'ViewTransition|addTransitionType' node_modules/react/index.js node_modules/react-dom/index.js node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts | head -80"

/bin/bash -c "sed -n '135,295p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/view-transitions.md && sed -n '360,390p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/view-transitions.md && sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/04-linking-and-navigating.md && printf '\\n--- React runtime exports ---\\n' && node --input-type=module -e \"import * as React from 'react'; console.log({version: React.version, ViewTransition: typeof React.ViewTransition, addTransitionType: typeof React.addTransitionType})\" && printf '\\n--- peer requirements ---\\n' && node -e \"console.log(require('./node_modules/next/package.json').peerDependencies)\""

/bin/bash -c "sed -n '63,142p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/view-transitions.md && sed -n '220,355p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/view-transitions.md && sed -n '372,390p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/view-transitions.md && printf '\\n--- React canary/latest ---\\n' && npm view react version && npm view react-dom version && printf '\\n--- Link transitionTypes support ---\\n' && rg -n \"transitionTypes\" node_modules/next/dist/client/link.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/client/link.js node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/02-components/link.md | head -50 && printf '\\n--- lockfile versions ---\\n' && rg -n '\"node_modules/(react|react-dom)\"|\"version\": \"19\\.' package-lock.json | head -30"
/bin/bash -c 'npm install --save-exact react@19.3.0 react-dom@19.3.0'

/bin/bash -c "git diff --check && git status --short && node --input-type=module -e \"import * as React from 'react'; console.log({version: React.version, ViewTransition: typeof React.ViewTransition})\""
/bin/bash -c 'npm run build'
/bin/bash -c "git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- app/page.tsx app/ProductGrid.tsx 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx' app/globals.css app/PageTransition.tsx package.json tsconfig.json"
/bin/bash -c "sed -n '1,140p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/view-transitions.md >/dev/null && npm ls react react-dom next --depth=0"
/bin/bash -c "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- tsconfig ---\\n' && cat tsconfig.json"
/bin/bash -c "sed -n '1,100p' app/page.tsx && sed -n '30,100p' 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx' && rg -n 'loading-reveal|slide-down|slide-up|reveal-up' app/globals.css"
/bin/bash -c 'find .next -depth -delete'
/bin/bash -c 'npm run build'
/bin/bash -c 'find .next -depth -delete'

/bin/bash -c "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: tsconfig.json
@@
-    \"lib\": [
-      \"dom\",
-      \"dom.iterable\",
-      \"esnext\"
-    ],
+    \"lib\": [\"dom\", \"dom.iterable\", \"esnext\"],
@@
-      \"@/*\": [
-        \"./*\"
-      ]
+      \"@/*\": [\"./*\"]
@@
-  \"include\": [
-    \"next-env.d.ts\",
-    \"**/*.ts\",
-    \"**/*.tsx\",
-    \".next/types/**/*.ts\",
-    \".next/dev/types/**/*.ts\"
-  ],
-  \"exclude\": [
-    \"node_modules\"
-  ]
+  \"include\": [\"next-env.d.ts\", \"**/*.ts\", \"**/*.tsx\", \".next/types/**/*.ts\"],
+  \"exclude\": [\"node_modules\"]
 }
*** End Patch
PATCH
apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Delete File: next-env.d.ts
*** End Patch
PATCH"
/bin/bash -c 'git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat'

/bin/bash -c "git diff -- app/PageTransition.tsx app/page.tsx app/ProductGrid.tsx 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx' app/globals.css package.json tsconfig.json && printf '\\n--- package lock versions ---\\n' && node -e \"const p=require('./package-lock.json'); console.log(p.packages[''].dependencies, p.packages['node_modules/react'].version, p.packages['node_modules/react-dom'].version)\""

/bin/bash -c "nl -ba app/PageTransition.tsx && printf '\\n--- view transition call sites ---\\n' && rg -n 'ViewTransition|transitionTypes|prefers-reduced-motion|::view-transition' app/ProductGrid.tsx app/page.tsx 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx' app/globals.css package.json"
/bin/bash -c 'git diff --check && test ! -e .next && test ! -e next-env.d.ts && printf '"'cleanup checks passed\\n' && npm ls react react-dom --depth=0"
